purpose: Reusable discovery registry for international and cross-country sources with subnational, point or gridded data. An entry is a candidate source, not evidence that a value is available or suitable for a particular country.

sources.provider: United Nations OCHA Centre for Humanitarian Data
sources.title: HDX Humanitarian API (HAPI)
sources.coverage: Humanitarian Response Plan countries and other countries where source data are available; coverage varies by subcategory and administrative level.
sources.availability_method: Query the data-availability endpoint by ISO3, subcategory and administrative level before requesting observations.

access.credential: app identifier generated for the application

sources.cache_policy: Store availability metadata, the exact country extract and request receipt after checking the originating dataset terms.
cautions: HAPI combines multiple originating sources; preserve original provider and transformation metadata.
Administrative level and coverage vary by country and subcategory.
HAPI administrative metadata does not include boundary geometry; obtain the corresponding boundary separately.
Do not sum overlapping humanitarian population statuses or sectors.

sources.provider: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees
sources.title: UNHCR Refugee Data Finder API
sources.coverage: Global country series with subnational or location detail where reported to UNHCR; detail varies by country, year and population type.
sources.availability_method: Query countries and years, then inspect demographics/location records for the country of asylum and the required population type.
sources.cache_policy: Store the exact paginated response, footnotes and query parameters; retain location text before any geographic crosswalk.
cautions: A reported location is not automatically an official administrative unit.
Population stocks, flows, asylum applications and durable solutions are different measures.
Small values are rounded for confidentiality; totals are approximate.
Check whether displaced populations are already included in census or administrative totals before combining them.

sources.title: Displacement Tracking Matrix API v3
sources.coverage: Countries and rounds assessed by DTM; coverage is event- and operation-dependent.
sources.availability_method: Use the DTM coverage matrix and API metadata to confirm country, assessment type, round and administrative level.
sources.cache_policy: Store non-sensitive aggregate extracts by assessment round with the API version and coverage record; never store credentials.
cautions: A DTM round is a snapshot of assessed locations, not a census of the whole resident population.
Keep IDPs, returnees and other assessed population groups separate.
Confirm whether missing areas were not assessed, had zero reported population, or were outside scope.

sources.provider: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification Global Partnership
sources.title: IPC-CH Public API
sources.coverage: Countries and areas with published IPC or Cadre Harmonisé analyses; periods and analyzed areas vary.
sources.availability_method: List analyses for the country, select an analysis ID and period, then retrieve area records and GeoJSON.
sources.cache_policy: Store the analysis metadata, validity period, area data, geometry and terms version as one versioned extract.
cautions: IPC analysis areas do not always correspond to administrative units.
Current and projected periods must remain separate.
Do not equate IPC phase population with an absolute-poverty measure.

sources.provider: UNICEF and participating national statistical offices
sources.title: Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys (MICS)
sources.coverage: Participating countries and survey rounds; reporting domains and geocoded access vary by survey.
sources.availability_method: Select the country and round, inventory reports, tabulations, questionnaires and datasets, then confirm the survey's reporting domains and access conditions.
sources.cache_policy: Cache public reports and approved aggregate extracts; preserve survey weights and design metadata; do not mirror restricted microdata.
cautions: MICS estimates are sample-survey estimates, not census counts.
Use weights and survey design for estimates and uncertainty.
Cluster coordinates may be displaced and must not be presented as exact household locations.

sources.provider: The DHS Program and participating national institutions
sources.title: Demographic and Health Surveys
sources.coverage: Participating countries and survey rounds; regions, modules and dataset access vary by survey.
sources.availability_method: Identify a country survey and recode files, confirm region variables and sample design, and separately request spatial files if needed.

access.credential: registration or project approval may be required

sources.cache_policy: Cache public metadata and approved aggregates; do not redistribute restricted recode or spatial files.
cautions: DHS estimates are sample-survey estimates and require weights and design variables.
Survey regions can differ from current administrative boundaries.
Cluster coordinates are displaced and access restrictions apply.

sources.title: WorldPop gridded population datasets
sources.coverage: Global or per-country gridded products depending on collection and release.
sources.availability_method: Query the catalogue by product alias and ISO3, select one documented release and record its method, year, resolution and constrained/unconstrained status.
sources.cache_policy: Keep the catalogue metadata and checksums; place large rasters in versioned object storage and country aggregates in derived storage.
cautions: Raster values are modeled spatial estimates and are not official small-area census counts.
Do not mix constrained and unconstrained products or different releases.
Aggregation to an administrative polygon inherits both raster and boundary uncertainty.

sources.title: Global Human Settlement Layer
sources.coverage: Global products with release-specific epochs and resolutions.
sources.availability_method: Choose a release, product, epoch, resolution and coordinate reference system from the data package before extracting a country or polygon.
sources.cache_policy: Store large global tiles outside Git with release identifiers and hashes; store only verified country-derived extracts with lineage.
cautions: Population surfaces are modeled/downscaled products rather than official local counts.
Settlement classes and legal administrative status answer different questions.
Keep product release, epoch, resolution and projection with every derivative.

sources.provider: United Nations Geospatial Information Section and Statistics Division
sources.title: Second Administrative Level Boundaries (SALB)
sources.coverage: Directory covers UN Member States; downloadable boundary and historical datasets are available only for some countries and periods.
sources.availability_method: Open the country page, record the national mapping authority, and separately check historical tables and each downloadable dataset and validity period.
sources.cache_policy: Cache only an available country release with its temporal validity, source authority and terms; retain an explicit no-dataset result.
cautions: A country listing does not mean a boundary download exists.
SALB availability and temporal validity vary substantially by country.
Confirm correspondence with the census and legal planning geography.

sources.provider: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
sources.title: WaPOR water productivity data
sources.coverage: Global 300 m layers; finer 100 m coverage for Africa and the Near East; selected 20 m areas, subject to the current catalogue.
sources.availability_method: Query the current catalogue for the target polygon, version, layer, temporal resolution and spatial resolution.

access.credential: none for WaPOR v3 API according to current documentation

sources.cache_policy: Store catalogue metadata and exact derived tiles outside Git; preserve version, layer, spatial/temporal resolution and processing geometry.
cautions: Coverage and resolution differ by region and layer.
Remote-sensing measurements are not administrative statistics.
Do not interpret agricultural water productivity as household water access.
